label: Language test result
must_be_valid: less than 2 years old at Express Entry profile creation and on the day the PR application (e-APR) is submitted
basis: IRCC Express Entry language test page

label: Educational credential assessment (ECA)
must_be_valid: less than 5 years old at profile creation and at application

label: Immigration medical exam
must_be_valid: results are valid 12 months; they must still be valid on the day of entry or landing
basis: IRCC Express Entry medical exam page; study permit entry rules

label: Police certificate (country where the person lives now)
must_be_valid: issued within 6 months before the PR application is submitted (Express Entry)
basis: IRCC Express Entry police certificates page

label: Express Entry profile
must_be_valid: a profile is removed after 12 months; a new one must be created
basis: IRCC Express Entry profile pages (Help Centre 1164)

label: Invitation to apply (Express Entry)
must_be_valid: the PR application must be submitted within 60 days
